taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-31, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 2792.1 | 0.92 | 0.92
2 | 1847.0 | 0.49 | 1.41
3 | 2743.7 | 1.01 | 2.42
4 | 1318.3 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we analyze the resistivities of the layers in groups of three.

**Resistivities:**
- Layer 1 ($r_1$): 2792.1 ohm-m
- Layer 2 ($r_2$): 1847.0 ohm-m
- Layer 3 ($r_3$): 2743.7 ohm-m
- Layer 4 ($r_4$): 1318.3 ohm-m

**Step 1: Evaluate the first group (Layers 1-2-3)**
- $r_1 = 2792.1$
- $r_2 = 1847.0$
- $r_3 = 2743.7$
- Comparison: $2792.1 > 1847.0 < 2743.7$ (i.e., $r_1 > r_2 < r_3$)
- This matches the pattern for **H**.

**Step 2: Evaluate the second group (Layers 2-3-4)**
- $r_2 = 1847.0$
- $r_3 = 2743.7$
- $r_4 = 1318.3$
- Comparison: $1847.0 < 2743.7 > 1318.3$ (i.e., $r_2 < r_3 > r_4$)
- This matches the pattern for **K**.

**Final Notation:**
The sequence of letters is HK.

{"curve_type": "HK"}
